decisions.reason: As the remaining single-tube air cooled condenser in a growing core business, it fits the firm's established engineering and service capabilities, though some residual portfolio-streamlining risk remains.
The tube liner supports repairs, upgrades, and installed-base lifecycle services, which are strategically valuable and well aligned with the firm's aftermarket model.
The customized industrial air cooler line matches the firm's solution-oriented offering and broad industrial demand, so it is likely to stay unless specific models are later rationalized.
These tube end repair inserts reinforce the profitable service and spare-parts business and therefore have only a low likelihood of being withdrawn in the next year.
